summary: Full backend and frontend testing of RAPTOR ConvoMemory app. All core flows working correctly.

issues: Action buttons (tree, query, delete) only visible on hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100). On mobile or touch devices these are invisible.

critical_code_review_comments: IndexRequest uses ConversationMessage with 'text' field but common convention is 'content'. Ensure frontend form and extension both use 'text' field or update model to accept both.

indexing_status dict is in-memory only - restarts reset all indexing state, but index_store persists trees. This inconsistency means status endpoint may return stale 'indexing' for completed tasks after restart.
reduction_pct can be negative for small conversations (expected per spec) but may confuse users - no clamping to 0% minimum.

success_rate.backend: 100% (health, conversations, settings, status, tree, query, index all pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 pages load correctly, navigation works, tree visualization shows 3-node tree)

seed_data_creation: test-index-flow conversation was indexed during testing with 12 messages about ML
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend RAPTOR_READY=True, all ML packages loaded. test-demo-1 (4 messages, 3 nodes) and test-index-flow (12 messages, 3 nodes) are indexed. Key schema: messages must have {role, text, index} NOT {role, content, index}. All 5 frontend pages working: Dashboard, Index, Tree View, Query, Settings. Tree visualization shows SVG nodes with ROOT/TOPIC/CHUNK levels. Query API works and returns answers via claude-sonnet-4-6.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/index requires ConversationMessage model with 'text' field. Standard Claude.ai extension likely sends 'content' field. Check /app/extension/ popup.js to verify message extraction uses correct field name before publishing extension.
